description: Intelligent email triage and draft generation system. Automatically classifies incoming emails, applies labels, generates contextual reply drafts, and optionally creates calendar events. Draft-only mode ensures human review before any action.
purpose: Email triage automation with AI-powered classification and draft generation

workflow_flow.stage_1_receive: Gmail webhook triggers on new email
workflow_flow.stage_2_clean: Extract and normalize email content (remove HTML, formatting)
workflow_flow.stage_3_classify: OpenAI GPT analyzes email and classifies intent (reply_needed, archive, action_required, etc.)
workflow_flow.stage_4_label: Map classification to Gmail labels and apply
workflow_flow.stage_5_check_headers: Detect if email requires a reply based on headers + classification
workflow_flow.stage_6_split: Split into two tracks: Reply-needed vs No-reply
workflow_flow.stage_7_draft: AI generates contextual reply draft (Claude or OpenAI)
workflow_flow.stage_9_review: Store draft for manual review (never auto-sends)

nodes.name: New Email Received
nodes.description: Webhook triggered when a new email arrives in inbox

nodes.name: Clean Email Content
nodes.description: Remove HTML tags, clean formatting, extract plain text and key metadata
nodes.logic: Strip HTML → Extract headers → Normalize whitespace → Flag attachments

nodes.name: Classify Email
nodes.description: AI analyzes email and assigns classification label

nodes.name: Map Classifications to Labels/Bins
nodes.description: Route email to appropriate Gmail labels based on classification

nodes.name: Check Headers Reply
nodes.description: Analyze email headers to determine if reply is necessary
checks: Is this a reply to user's email?

nodes.name: Split Classifications/Labels
nodes.description: Branch: route to reply generation OR archive

nodes.name: Apply Classification Labels
nodes.description: Apply computed labels to email in Gmail

nodes.name: Generate Reply Draft
nodes.description: AI generates a contextual reply based on email content and user preferences

nodes.name: Check Calendar/Confirming Enabled
nodes.description: Detect if email references a meeting/event or needs calendar action

nodes.name: Create Calendar Event
nodes.description: If event detected, create calendar entry automatically

nodes.name: Create Smart Event
nodes.description: Create event with smart parsing of dates/times from email

nodes.name: Generate Reply Draft Mode
nodes.description: Finalize reply draft for manual review

nodes.name: Apply Smart Labels
nodes.description: Apply secondary smart labels based on content analysis

nodes.name: Apply Automation Error
nodes.description: Catch any errors and log them for debugging

nodes.name: OpenAI/GPT Model
nodes.description: OpenAI API connection for classification and draft generation

nodes.name: Classification Workflows
nodes.description: Modular sub-workflows for specific classification types (urgent, spam, etc.)

credentials: Claude API key (optional, if using for drafts)
configuration: Automation rules (which classifications trigger which actions)

setupInstructions.step_1: Create Gmail labels in your Gmail account (via Settings → Labels → Create new label)
setupInstructions.step_2: Add n8n OAuth2 credentials for Gmail API
setupInstructions.step_3: Add OpenAI API key to n8n credentials
setupInstructions.step_4: Configure email signature and reply tone in Global Config
setupInstructions.step_5: Set up Google Calendar API (optional, for auto-event creation)
setupInstructions.step_6: Test with a sample email using 'Test Workflow' button
setupInstructions.step_7: Enable Gmail webhook trigger to activate automation

draftOnlyMode.description: Workflow generates draft replies but NEVER auto-sends
draftOnlyMode.purpose: Human review ensures quality and appropriateness before sending
draftOnlyMode.draft_storage: Stored in Notion or Google Drive for manual review
draftOnlyMode.user_workflow: 1. Review draft 2. Edit if needed 3. Send manually from Gmail

extensibility.modular_design: Each stage can be extended or replaced

error_handling.email_parsing_failed: Log error, skip draft generation, send alert
error_handling.calendar_creation_failed: Log error, continue with email classification

github_description: 📧 Personal Email Automation System | AI-powered email classification, smart labeling, draft reply generation | Draft-only mode for safety | OpenAI + Gmail + Google Calendar
safety_features: Manual review required before any action
Rate limiting to prevent API abuse
Header analysis to prevent reply-all mistakes
future_roadmap: Custom AI model fine-tuning per user
